issues.explanation: In 宦官专权, this is a verb meaning to monopolize or wield power arbitrarily, not the noun “autocracy”.
issues.suggested_fix: to monopolize power; to wield power arbitrarily

issues.explanation: 干政 is a useful lexical verb meaning to interfere in government affairs, but it is split into 干 and 政.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as 干政: to interfere in government affairs

issues.explanation: 反 is an adverb here, meaning “instead” or “on the contrary”, not a grammatical particle.
和 is a conjunction meaning “and”, not a grammatical particle.
已 is an adverb meaning “already”, not a grammatical particle.
又 is an adverb meaning “again”, not a grammatical particle.
In 刘备为中山靖王刘胜之后, 之后 means “descendant of”, not “after”.
In 两耳垂肩, 耳 and 垂 are separate: “ears hang down to the shoulders”.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 耳 + 垂; 垂 means “to hang down”

issues.explanation: 与 is a preposition meaning “with”, not a grammatical particle.
The numeral and horse classifier are separate useful units.
The numeral and liang measure unit are separate useful units.
The numeral and jin measure unit are separate useful units.
In 投在刘焉麾下, 投 means to join or serve under someone, not “place; put”.
在 functions as a preposition in 投在刘焉麾下, not a grammatical particle.
麾下 means “under someone’s command”, not “troops”.
issues.suggested_fix: under one’s command; under one’s banner

issues.explanation: This occurrence splits the personal name 关羽 into two name segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as the name 关羽

issues.explanation: The local sentence requires 大风 “strong wind” and 火攻 “attack with fire”; 风火 is a false combined segment.
issues.suggested_fix: Resegment the surrounding text as 大风 + 火攻

issues.explanation: 长社 is a place name and should not be split into 长 and 社.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as the place name 长社

issues.explanation: 孝廉 is a historical term for a recommendation based on filial piety and integrity, not two independent words here.
者 nominalizes the preceding phrase, meaning “one who”; it is a grammatical particle.
In 威名大震, this means that his reputation became very prominent or widely renowned, not “greatly shook”.
issues.suggested_fix: to become widely renowned; to make a great impact

issues.explanation: 左丰 is a personal name and should remain together.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as the name 左丰

issues.explanation: 轻慢 is a lexical verb meaning to treat someone with contempt or disdain, not two separate verbs here.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as 轻慢: to slight; to treat with contempt

issues.explanation: 无礼 is a lexical adjective meaning “discourteous” or “impolite”, not separate 无 and 礼 in this context.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as 无礼: impolite; discourteous
